questions.stem: Where is testosterone produced and what is its main role?

options.text: In the adrenal glands; it controls the fight or flight response
In the testes; it controls male secondary sexual characteristics and sperm production
In the pituitary gland; it controls growth
In the ovaries; it controls the menstrual cycle

questions.explanation: Testosterone is produced by the testes. It stimulates sperm production and the development of male secondary sexual characteristics such as a deeper voice and facial hair.
